message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise‑complaint with the **Atlanta City Council** (or the local police department, which will forward it to the council if necessary).  

**How to file a complaint**

| Step | What to do | Where to go / Who to call |
|------|------------|---------------------------|
| 1 | Gather details (time, location, description of the noise, any witnesses). | — |
| 2 | File online through the City of Atlanta’s official portal. | https://www.atlantaga.gov/ |
| 3 | If you prefer to speak to someone, call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line. | 404‑656‑4000 |
| 4 | If the issue persists, you can also contact the City Council directly. | 404‑656‑4000 (same line) or email the council office at council@atlantaga.gov |

**Key points**

* The city’s noise ordinance (Title 10, Chapter 5 of the Atlanta Municipal Code) sets the legal limits for noise and provides the enforcement process.  
* Complaints can be filed 24/7 via the online portal; the council will review and, if warranted, take action.  
* If you’re dealing with a recurring problem, keep a log of dates and times—this helps the council assess the situation.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the exact link to the online complaint form or more details on the noise ordinance!
